fusions.name: Flung Brand
fusions.desc: Flings a burning stick for 4 damage, setting the target [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Fanned Torch Sweep
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. You sweep a torch through a cone 3.5 tiles long for 9 damage, with a 50% chance to leave each target [Burning] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Smouldering Pelt
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are set [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Singed Temper
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
